description: x402 paid API builder kit. The complete per-call selling methodology: intake, the two-route architecture, a token-fill Express server scaffold, testnet verification, the production switch, the pricing bands, and the discovery-writing rules, for turning any tool, dataset, or computation into a paid API that buyers and agents pay for per call in USDC. One call returns the full kit; the buyer's agent builds the endpoint itself. Price: $15.00 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.
